farmBuilds.name: 5-2-0 Banana Central
farmBuilds.note: Estimate: 5 crates at Central value with Valuable Bananas; also buffs all BRFs +25%.

farmBuilds.name: 2-0-3 Marketplace
farmBuilds.note: 16 auto packets/round. 10% higher sellback than other farms.

farmBuilds.name: 2-0-4 Central Market
farmBuilds.note: 16 × $70 base ($1,120) before middle-path bonus; each CM also buffs Merchantmen +10%.

farmBuilds.name: 0-2-3 Merchantman
farmBuilds.note: $200/round base (wiki). Middle crosspath adds Grape/Hot Shot defense.

farmBuilds.name: 0-2-4 Favored Trades
farmBuilds.note: $500/round; boosts sellback of nearby towers. Prioritized by Trade Empire.

farmBuilds.name: 0-0-5 Trade Empire
farmBuilds.note: $800/round itself + buffs up to 20 boats. Worth it from ~16 Merchantmen.

farmBuilds.name: 2-3-0 Monkey Bank
farmBuilds.note: Effective $/rd incl. interest — must be collected manually. Upgrade to IMF for loans.

strategies.title: Land Meta
points: Core: 4-2-0 Banana Research Facilities ($1,950 a round each with Valuable Bananas).
Overclock raises a BRF or Banana Central from 5 to 9 crates per round.
Banana Central (5-2-0) adds +25% to every BRF on the map.
Late game: BRF spam with Overclocks, then sell everything at the end of round 119.

strategies.title: Hands-off
points: Marketplaces auto-collect 16 cash packets every round.
2-0-3 is the usual pick while saving up; with Monkey Knowledge 0-2-3 earns slightly more.
Marketplace and up sell back for 10% more than other farms, so they are cheap to liquidate into BRFs.
Healthy Bananas MK makes them generate lives, which helps against Lych.

strategies.title: Water Meta
points: Merchantmen earn $200 a round; each Central Market adds +10% (up to 10).
Trade Empire is worth it from about 16 Merchantmen and buffs up to 20 boats.
Upgrade to Favored Trades once 20 Merchantmen exist.
The wiki's Navarch of the Seas plan saves about $980,000 for a 40-Merchantmen setup.

strategies.title: Active Tricks
points: Cash out the bank at about $1,100 saved.
Deposit into the IMF until about $8,300–8,500, then collect near $11,500.
Monkeyopolis absorbs every farm in its radius, so place farms inside it first.

bossCheckpoints.defense: Defend the lead rounds 28 and 30 (and 26 against Dreadbloon), then a tier 1 boss defense.
bossCheckpoints.economy: Rounds 1–20: put spare cash into income. Two 2-0-0 farms, then a Marketplace or Bank → IMF Loan → Monkeyopolis plan.

bossCheckpoints.defense: Hold the tier 1 boss, then rebuild. Aim for two Bloon Traps by round 47.
bossCheckpoints.economy: Bloon Trap (0-1-4) and Rubber to Gold under Monkeyopolis, then Banana Central or Merchantmen on water.

bossCheckpoints.defense: Tier 2 boss defense; start building pops toward Paragons.
bossCheckpoints.economy: BRFs with Overclock; Trade Empire fleet on water-heavy maps.

bossCheckpoints.defense: Tier 3 boss: Sun Temples with $45,000+ of support sacrifices, or Paragons.
bossCheckpoints.economy: Megaopolis option; keep scaling BRFs and Monkey Cities.

bossCheckpoints.cashTarget: Sell everything at end of R119
bossCheckpoints.defense: Four Paragons at Degree 40+ handle nearly every boss, including Elite.
bossCheckpoints.economy: Sell all farms at the end of round 119 and spend it all on the final defense.
